details:
Q1. Which part of this repository should this issue target?
Choices:
A. One specific workflow, script, or file that you name (RECOMMENDED)
B. One specific pipeline phase — clarify, plan, implement, review/autofix, orchestrate, or validate — plus the behavior to change (RECOMMENDED)
C. Docs/README/setup guidance only
Q2. What concrete improvement do you want in that area?
Choices:
A. Fix a bug or failing behavior — include current behavior and expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability or performance — include the symptom/metric to improve (RECOMMENDED)
C. Improve documentation or usability — include what is confusing/missing and who it affects (RECOMMENDED)
Q3. What context should implementation use as the source of truth?
Choices:
A. A GitHub issue/PR/workflow run number or exact error text (RECOMMENDED)
B. Exact file path(s), workflow name(s), or script name(s) to inspect (RECOMMENDED)
C. A consumer-repo example showing the downstream problem
